description: Archipelago implementation for Chrono Gear: Warden of Time.

v0.1.0.description: This is the initial release of the Chrono Gear AP World. There are currently issues with the mod loader preventing the self set up from working, see the readme of the mod's repo for more information on that, but the AP World is fully functioning. See the [docs folder](https://github.com/Kalithar/ArchipelagoChronoGear/tree/main/worlds/chrono_gear/docs) for the setup guide and known major issues.
v0.1.0.title: v0.1.0

v0.2.0.description: APWorld update for compatibility with the 0.2 update for the mod. See the mod's repo for the list of changes.
